background_image_description: Full-canvas vertical pinstripe pattern on a subtle off-white textured paper. Alternating stripes of very light gray (#ececec) and near-white (#f9f9f7), each ~36 px wide, extend the full height. The surface shows faint watercolor-paper grain and soft shadowing.

nodes.asset_description: Seamless off-white paper with vertical pale-gray pinstripes; gentle fiber/grain texture and very soft lighting variations across the entire canvas.

nodes.svg_description: Hand-drawn cobalt-blue (#1f3f93) ink illustration of a large oval serving plate with a double-line border and an inner ring of evenly spaced dots; inside the plate is a sketch of a lobster oriented vertically with raised claws, segmented body and tail, long antennae, and expressive, variable-width brush strokes. The drawing includes a few white highlight streaks suggesting gloss on the plate and shell.
